prompt_output_contract.company_input_rule: 회사 입력은 실회사 ㈜루트랩의 등록 사실이며 origin은 company_brochure·homepage·user_interview·agent_proposal 중 하나다. status가 confirmed인 사실만 보유·수행·자격의 근거다. proposed(에이전트 제안값)와 unknown은 확인되지 않은 값이며 보유·미보유 어느 쪽 근거도 아니다.
prompt_output_contract.evidence_rule: Copy source_sha256, block_key, and exact quote from the supplied frozen units. Never invent evidence or company facts.
prompt_output_contract.input_rule: Use only the frozen batch, ontology, deterministic compare rows, role inputs, and synthesis input supplied for this call.
prompt_output_contract.repair_rule: A validation_repair request may repair JSON syntax or the fixed output schema only. Return a complete replacement for the identical frozen input without changing identifiers, evidence, facts, or meaning.
prompt_output_contract.unknown_rule: Preserve unknown and null. A missing fact, partial path, unmapped requirement, or unaccepted condition is not proof of absence or compliance.

stages.instruction: Extract every material requirement in the supplied batch into bidops.requirement-extract.v1. Preserve exact quotes and source block identities; represent uncertain values as unknown.
Assess eligibility and economics from the deterministic requirement comparisons only, using bidops.verdict-role.v1 and preserving every unknown and condition.
Assess technical fit from the deterministic requirement comparisons only, using bidops.verdict-role.v1 and preserving every unknown and condition.
Assess operations risk from the deterministic requirement comparisons only, using bidops.verdict-role.v1 and preserving every unknown and condition.
Synthesize the three validated role outputs into bidops.practitioner-verdict.v1. Preserve conflicts and unknowns; do not produce a bid Go/No-Go decision.
